description: Standardized control capabilities for a connected FERAL Robot Node SDK actuator.

endpoints.description: Moves the robotic chassis or arm in a specified mapping direction. Runs on a paired FERAL Robot Node daemon over the WebSocket link, not on this machine: with no robot daemon connected the call returns 503 and nothing moves.

params.name: direction
params.description: The cardinal or relative direction to move (e.g. forward, left, up).

params.name: speed
params.description: The speed percentage from 0 to 80. Above 80 the call is refused outright by the safety resolver before it reaches the daemon, so never send a larger number. Values at or below 80 are dispatched after the operator confirms. Defaults to 30.

endpoints.returns_description: {status, stdout}: whatever the robot daemon's executor reported for the move.

endpoints.description: Actuates the robotic end-effector to open or close. Runs on a paired FERAL Robot Node daemon over the WebSocket link; with no robot daemon connected the call returns 503 and nothing moves.

params.name: action
params.description: Whether to open or close the gripper.

endpoints.returns_description: {status, stdout}: whatever the robot daemon's executor reported for the gripper.
